findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_entity, explain_hbmeasure, get_agent_report_catalog, get_x402_payment_requirements · Private data: explain_denied_claim · Public sink: get_entity, get_agent_report_catalog, get_x402_payment_requirements · Destructive: explain_hbmeasure, get_agent_report_catalog.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_entity, explain_hbmeasure, get_agent_report_catalog, get_x402_payment_requirements · Private data: explain_denied_claim · Public sink: get_entity, get_agent_report_catalog, get_x402_payment_requirements · Destructive: explain_hbmeasure, get_agent_report_catalog

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
